items.html: This is the secret of "a woman of valor is the crown of her husband," who, in the future, will be greater than the sun, and this is the secret of "she became the head of the corner." For when Malchut is revealed below, it is revealed from the secret of that Rosh that is not known [Reisha deLo Ityada]. And this matter will explain to you how every phase of the Malchut of the upper world itself becomes the phase of the Atik of the world below it. Understand this. It follows that the nine Sefirot are of AA, and the supernal Rosh that is not known, above them all, is the phase of Atik.
